tagline: Watches your weekly model spend and warns you well before the allowance runs out
description: Nobody notices a budget draining until the week it stops working. body:
## What it does

Nobody notices a budget draining until the week it stops working. This reads the weekly figures off your Cursor spending page, separates them out by where the money actually went, and puts a note in front of each owner at a quarter, a half, three quarters and nine tenths of what they are allowed. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SuddenlyJon shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
